reviews: Spent three hours building a massive skybridge just to get wiped out by the Twins in thirty seconds, 10/10 would suffer again.
Digging all the way down to the Underworld and beating the Wall of Flesh to unlock Hardmode is still one of the best progression moments in any sandbox game.
The boss variety and weapon crafting tree are insane—going from a copper shortsword to firing rainbow cats from a sword never gets old.
Inventory management becomes a total nightmare late game once you have fifty different accessories, potions, and crafting materials cluttering your chests.
Summoner class feels super weak early on until you finally farm enough materials for a decent whip and minion staff.
Fishing quests for the Angler are pure pain if you're trying to craft the Cell Phone, the RNG drop rates are brutal.
Playing Master Mode co-op with friends while trying to contain the Crimson spread before it eats our entire jungle biome is pure chaos.
Boss fights and exploration are phenomenal, especially underground biomes like the Glowing Mushroom caves and the Dungeon.
Nice game, really fun to play.
